sources.title: Minerals
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: National minerals guidance explains Mineral Safeguarding Areas, Minerals Consultation Areas, landbanks and the need to avoid needless sterilisation of mineral resources.

sources.title: London Plan Chapter 9 Sustainable Infrastructure
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Policy SI10 requires mineral planning authorities to identify safeguarding areas and protect aggregate wharves, railheads and related facilities; Havering has a specific aggregate landbank apportionment.

sources.title: London Aggregates Working Party
sources.verified_claim: The London Aggregates Working Party publishes monitoring reports and safeguarding consultation guidance used to track aggregate supply and safeguarding issues.

sources.title: Safeguarded Wharves Directions
sources.verified_claim: Current safeguarding directions require planning applications affecting listed safeguarded wharves to be referred to the Mayor; this is location-specific.

sources.title: Safeguarded Wharves Reviews
sources.verified_claim: GLA records the review history of the safeguarded wharf network and the 2021 updated directions; review status alone is not candidate intersection evidence.

sources.title: Havering Local Plan 2016-2031 Adopted 2021
sources.verified_claim: Havering's adopted plan contains mineral safeguarding and extraction policies, reflecting its London aggregate apportionment; only mapped overlap can bind the sample parcel.

sources.title: Aggregates working parties: annual reports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Government hosts regional aggregate monitoring reports covering extraction, sales, supply, demand, marine aggregates and recycled/secondary aggregates.

sources.title: Aggregate minerals survey for Great Britain, 2023
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The 2023 survey provides national and sub-national aggregate sales, flows, consumption, reserves and planning-application data; it is market/context evidence, not parcel safeguarding evidence.
